# Sirach Chapter 49 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic Equivalent)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 49 | **Date:** 2026-03-17

---

**49:1** The memory of Josiah is like perfectly blended incense — it is sweet as honey in every mouth, like music at a wine-soaked feast.

**49:2** He did what was right in turning the people back; he swept away the abominations of sin.

**49:3** He set his whole heart on the Lord; in an age of wickedness he made piety take root.

**49:4** Except for David, Hezekiah, and Josiah, all the kings of Judah sinned greatly, abandoning the law of the Most High — and they came to ruin, every last one.

**49:5** So they handed their power over to foreigners and their glory to another nation,

**49:6** who burned the holy city, the city God had chosen, and left its streets desolate — just as Jeremiah had prophesied.

**49:7** They had mistreated Jeremiah, though God had made him a prophet from the womb — to uproot and tear down and destroy, but also to build and to plant.

**49:8** It was Ezekiel who saw the vision of glory — what God showed him above the cherubim-throne.

**49:9** He also mentioned Job, who walked faithfully on every path of righteousness.

**49:10** May the bones of the Twelve Prophets bud fresh from where they rest! They comforted the people of Jacob and rescued them through the power of confident hope.

**49:11** What words are big enough for Zerubbabel? He was like a signet ring on God's right hand.

**49:12** And Jeshua son of Jozadak — who with Zerubbabel built the house of the Lord and raised up the holy temple, destined for eternal glory.

**49:13** Nehemiah's memory, too, is great: he rebuilt our fallen walls, set up the gates with bolts and bars, and restored our ruined homes.

**49:14** No one like Enoch has ever been born on earth — for he was taken up from it.

**49:15** Nor was there ever a man like Joseph — and even his body was kept from decay.

**49:16** Shem and Seth were honored among people — but Adam, in his creation, stood above all living things.
